name: bto-cv
description: Convert original CVs into editable BTO Word documents and organize candidates in the Trello Talent Pool using the shared converter.

interface.shortDescription: BTO Word CVs and Trello candidate cards.
defaultPrompt: Convert the attached original CV into an editable BTO Word document.
Create a fictional BTO Word CV to test the formatting and native bullet lists.
$bto-cv $trello — Convert the attached CV and create its Talent Pool card with both CVs attached.
interface.longDescription: Create an editable .docx using the BTO reference banner, Century Gothic fonts, measured spacing and native square bullet lists. Preserves supplied facts. Includes a deterministic Word generator and optional HTML preview. A separate Trello skill can create Talent Pool cards and attach original and BTO CVs using the bundled local Windows uploader. Requires Trello access and one-time local credential setup; no extra paid automation service.
